summary: This task produced no real work to review: the branch has zero commits beyond its base checkout (git log master..HEAD is empty, reflog shows only the initial worktree reset at task creation time), and PROGRESS.md explicitly lists 'Not started' under Completed with no items checked off. A naive `git diff master` against the live master branch appears to show a large deletion-heavy diff, but that is an artifact of master having since merged an unrelated PR (#101, 'consolidate 6 dispatch/status scripts') that this stale branch predates -- it is not this worker's diff and is unrelated to the 'mother-router-and-roster-persistent-memo' task scope. Per the standing NO-DUPLICATION rule, a claim of completion (or in this case, a task reaching review) must be backed by verified real code changes, which do not exist here.
